# Initialize Seurat Object

First, we'll read run our setup script, which will define paths and load in the necessary libraries. 

```{r}
library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper_Seurat.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))
```

## Read in data

```{r}
seq1_data_list <- list.files(seq1_dir) %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map( ~ Seurat::Read10X(
    file.path(seq1_dir, ..1, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
  ))
names(seq1_data_list) <- paste0("seq1_", names(seq1_data_list))

seq2_data_list <- list.files(seq2_dir) %>%
  set_names() %>%
  map( ~ Seurat::Read10X(
    file.path(seq2_dir, ..1, "outs", "filtered_feature_bc_matrix")
  ))
names(seq2_data_list) <- paste0("seq2_", names(seq2_data_list))

data_list <- c(seq1_data_list, seq2_data_list)

so_list <- data_list %>%
  imap(~ Seurat::CreateSeuratObject(..1$`Gene Expression`, project = ..2)) %>%
  map(run_seurat_rna_workflow,
      run_scale = FALSE,
      run_clustering = FALSE)

so_list <- map2(
  so_list, data_list,
  function(so, data) {
    so[["HTO"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = data$`Antibody Capture`)
    so <-
      NormalizeData(so, assay = "HTO", normalization.method = "CLR")
    return(so)
  })
```

## HTO demultiplexing

### Explore

```{r}
hto_tidy_list <- so_list %>% map(get_hto_tidy)
hto_df_list <- hto_tidy_list %>% map(~..1 %>% pivot_wider(id_cols = cell, names_from = hashtag))
```

At a glance, you can see that the quality of the hashtag binding varied across sample, and that it's particularly bad in sample d1 from the first sequencing run. 

```{r, fig.asp = 1/2, fig.width = 14}
cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = imap(hto_tidy_list, ~plot_hto_ridges(..1) + ggtitle(..2)), ncol = 4)
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1/2, fig.width = 14}
hto_df_list %>% 
    imap(~plot_hto_density(..1) + ggtitle(..2)) %>% 
    cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 4)
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1}
plot_grid(
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list$seq1_sample_a1,
        x = hashtag1,
        y = hashtag3
    ) + ggtitle("a1"),
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list$seq1_sample_a1,
        x = hashtag2,
        y = hashtag3
    ) + ggtitle("a1"),
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list$seq1_sample_d1,
        x = hashtag1,
        y = hashtag3
    ) + ggtitle("d1"),
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list$seq1_sample_d1,
        x = hashtag2,
        y = hashtag3
    ) + ggtitle("d1"),
    ncol = 2
)
```

### Clustering HTO

I'm going to use K-medoid (aka PAM) clustering. Seurat (as of 2022-01-11, see https://satijalab.org/seurat/articles/hashing_vignette.html) uses Clara, which is a faster implementation of K-medoid clustering. It's also implemented in the `cluster` package so I use it here. 

```{r}
# this step may take a while to compute
so_list <- map(so_list, run_seurat_hto_clustering)
```

```{r}
hto_df_list_ann <- map2(hto_df_list,
     so_list,
     ~ ..1 %>%
         left_join(as_tibble(..2@meta.data, rownames = "cell"),
                   by = "cell"))
```

```{r, fig.asp = 1/2, fig.width = 14}
hto_df_list_ann %>% 
    imap(~plot_hto_density(..1, group_str = "hash.ID") + ggtitle(..2)) %>% 
    cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = ., ncol = 4)
```


```{r, fig.asp = 1}
plot_grid(
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list_ann$seq1_sample_a1,
        x = hashtag1,
        y = hashtag3, group_str = "hash.ID"
    ) + ggtitle("a1"),
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list_ann$seq1_sample_a1,
        x = hashtag2,
        y = hashtag3, group_str = "hash.ID"
    ) + ggtitle("a1"),
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list_ann$seq1_sample_d1,
        x = hashtag1,
        y = hashtag3, group_str = "hash.ID"
    ) + ggtitle("d1"),
    plot_hto_density(
        hto_df_list_ann$seq1_sample_d1,
        x = hashtag2,
        y = hashtag3, group_str = "hash.ID"
    ) + ggtitle("d1"),
    ncol = 2
)
```

### Manually determining Sample C1

```{r}
t1 <- 0.6
t2 <- 0.57
plot_grid(
    hto_df_list$seq1_sample_c1 %>% plot_hto_density() + 
        geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = t1),
    hto_df_list$seq2_sample_c1 %>% plot_hto_density() + 
        geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = t2)
)
```


```{r}
plot_grid(
    hto_df_list$seq1_sample_c1 %>% 
        mutate(hash.ID = ifelse(hashtag2 > hashtag1*t1, "hashtag2", "hashtag1")) %>% 
        plot_hto_density(group_str = "hash.ID", limit = 2, bins = 20),
    hto_df_list$seq2_sample_c1 %>% 
        mutate(hash.ID = ifelse(hashtag2 > hashtag1*t2, "hashtag2", "hashtag1")) %>% 
        plot_hto_density(group_str = "hash.ID", limit = 2, bins = 20)
)
```

```{r}
hto_metadata_s1_c1 <- hto_df_list$seq1_sample_c1 %>%
    mutate(hash.ID = ifelse(hashtag2 > hashtag1 * t1, "hashtag2", "hashtag1")) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell") %>% 
    select(hash.ID) 
so_list$seq1_sample_c1 <- Seurat::AddMetaData(so_list$seq1_sample_c1, 
                                              metadata = hto_metadata_s1_c1)

hto_metadata_s2_c1 <- hto_df_list$seq2_sample_c1 %>%
    mutate(hash.ID = ifelse(hashtag2 > hashtag1 * t2, "hashtag2", "hashtag1"))  %>%
    column_to_rownames("cell") %>%
    select(hash.ID) 
so_list$seq2_sample_c1 <- Seurat::AddMetaData(so_list$seq2_sample_c1, 
                                              metadata = hto_metadata_s2_c1)
```

### Evaluation of demultiplexing

```{r}
hto_df_ann <- map2_dfr(hto_df_list,
                       so_list,
                       ~ ..1 %>%
                           left_join(as_tibble(..2@meta.data, rownames = "cell"),
                                     by = "cell"),
                       .id = "sample")
```

```{r}
hto_df_ann %>% 
    group_by(sample, hash.ID) %>% 
    summarise(across(starts_with("hashtag"), mean)) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = str_subset(colnames(.), "hashtag"), 
                 names_to = "hashtag") %>% 
    ungroup() %>% 
    separate(sample, into = c("sequencing", "sample"), extra = "merge", sep = "_") %>% 
    mutate(sample = str_extract(sample, "sample_.")) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(hash.ID, hashtag, fill = value) + 
    geom_tile() + 
    facet_grid(sequencing~sample) + 
    coord_fixed() + 
    labs(fill = "Mean expr.", x = "Identity", y = "Expression") + 
    scale_fill_viridis(na.value = "white") + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), 
          axis.line = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks = element_blank())
```

## Set up Seurat Object

```{r}
so <- merge(so_list[[1]], so_list[2:length(so_list)], 
            add.cell.ids = names(so_list))
```

So many cells!

```{r}
new_metadata <- so@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(orig.ident, hash.ID) %>%
    tidyr::separate(
        orig.ident,
        into = c("seq", "sample"),
        sep = "_",
        extra = "merge"
    ) %>% 
    mutate(mouse = paste0(sample, "__", hash.ID))
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = new_metadata)
```

```{r}
new_metadata <- so@meta.data %>%
    dplyr::select(sample) %>% 
    mutate(genotype = case_when(
        sample %>% startsWith("sample_a") ~ "Ctrl", 
        sample %>% startsWith("sample_c") ~ "Ctrl", 
        TRUE ~ "B2m KO"
    )) %>% 
    mutate(treatment = case_when(
        sample %>% startsWith("sample_a") ~ "Isotype", 
        sample %>% startsWith("sample_d") ~ "Isotype", 
        TRUE ~ "CD40 agonist"
    )) %>% 
    mutate(group = paste0(genotype, "__", treatment)) %>% 
    mutate(group = factor(group, levels = c("Ctrl__Isotype", "Ctrl__CD40 agonist", 
                                            "B2m KO__Isotype", "B2m KO__CD40 agonist")))
so <- AddMetaData(so, metadata = new_metadata)
```

## Run Clustering Workflow with no filters

```{r}
Idents(so) <- "sample"
VlnPlot(
    so,
    features = c("nCount_RNA",  "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"),
    pt.size = 0
)
```

```{r}
so <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(so, file.path(results_dir, "so_raw.rds"))
```

## Filter low quality cells

```{r}
so_filtered <- subset(so, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & percent.mt < 10)
```

```{r}
Idents(so_filtered) <- "sample"
VlnPlot(
    so_filtered,
    features = c("nCount_RNA",  "nFeature_RNA", "percent.mt"),
    pt.size = 0
)
```

Filtered out this many cells: 

```{r}
ncol(so) - ncol(so_filtered)
```

This many cells remaining: 

```{r}
ncol(so_filtered)
```

```{r}
so_filtered <- run_seurat_rna_workflow(so_filtered)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(so_filtered, file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
```
